 Harris County early voting turnout tracker: Daily vote totals for November 2026 election
 By Barbi Barbee FOX 26 Houston 2026 Elections Published  October 21, 2026 10:40 AM CDT Share
 Copy Link 
 Email 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Reddit 
 Published  October 21, 2026 10:40 AM CDT Record-breaking or near record breaking early voting numbers reported 
 The November mid-term election is bringing voters to the polls across not just the Houston area, but surrounding areas as well. FOX 26's Randy Wallace has the latest. 
 The Brief
 Follow updated in-person voting totals and mail ballots received in Harris County throughout early voting. 
 More than 104,600 people voted in person on Oct. 19, surpassing the county's previous first-day midterm record. 
 Early voting runs through Oct. 30, ahead of Election Day on Nov. 3, 2026. 
 HOUSTON - Harris County had a record-setting start to early voting for the Nov. 3 midterm election.
 Early voting began on Oct. 19 and runs until Oct. 30.
 We are tracking voter turnout in Harris County each day of early voting.
 Early voting record shattered
 By the numbers:
 Harris County voters broke a record on the first day of early voting for the Nov. 3 midterm election.
 By the time polls closed on Monday, the election office reported a little over 104,600 in-person voters on the first day of early voting.
 The backstory:
 That surpassed the county's previous record for first-day early voting turnout in a midterm election that was set in 2018 at 63,188 votes.
 Tracker: How many have voted in Harris County?
 See how many people are voting in person in Harris County daily, and how many mail ballots have been received. The numbers are updated after polls close each day.
 Early voting continues 
 Early voting runs from Oct. 19 to Oct. 30. Hours at the polls for early voting vary by county and precincts.
 In order to vote in the November 3, 2026 election, you must have been registered by Oct. 5, 2026.
 Click here to check if you are registered to vote. 
 Find your polling location
 Harris County registered voters are allowed to cast their ballot at any of the polling locations in the county during early voting.
 To help you find a polling location near you, the county has an interactive map that allows you to search by zip code or address.  Click here to access the map.
